description: This file contains core game logic and database operations for a Tic Tac Toe game API, including game creation, joining, moves, status retrieval, leaderboard, and match history.

methods.name: str initial_board()
methods.description: Creates and returns a string representing an empty Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: List[str] board_to_list(board: str)
methods.description: Converts a board string into a list of characters.

methods.name: str list_to_board(lst: List[str])
methods.description: Converts a list of characters into a board string.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_winner(board: str)
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current board state and returns the winning symbol ('X' or 'O') or None.

methods.name: bool board_full(board: str)
methods.description: Checks if the board is full (all cells are 'X' or 'O').

methods.name: int create_game(player_x_id: int)
methods.description: Creates a new game record in the database and returns the new game ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] join_game(player_id: int, game_id: int)
methods.description: Allows a player to join an existing waiting game as player_o and returns the current game status.

methods.name: List[dict] get_available_games()
methods.description: Fetches a list of games that are waiting for a second player.

methods.name: dict get_game_status(game_id: int, req_user: int)
methods.description: Returns the current status and moves of a specified game.

methods.name: dict make_move(game_id: int, player_id: int, cell_pos: int, symbol: str)
methods.description: Validates and records a player's move, updates game state, and handles game completion logic including leaderboard updates.

methods.name: List[LeaderboardEntry] get_leaderboard(limit=10)
methods.description: Fetches top players ordered by number of wins.

methods.name: List[GameSummary] get_match_history(user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves recent finished games involving the specified user, showing opponent and outcome.

ctags.name: get_game_status
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_game_status(game_id: int, req_user: int) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: join_game
ctags.pattern: /^async def join_game(player_id: int, game_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.name: make_move
ctags.pattern: /^async def make_move(game_id: int, player_id: int, cell_pos: int, symbol: str) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (game_id: int, player_id: int, cell_pos: int, symbol: str)
